notes: Generic PASS does not certify EMG quality: see EMG005_quality_report.md for drift, all 50 Hz harmonics, and action/rest assessment. All eight channels are skin EMG in this recording.

Binary sequence inspection: one startup rollback at row359; first359 payloads repeat at row512. CSV timestamps are row-index derived and hide this event. Decoder 65024 missing count is not physical loss evidence; see EMG005_quality_report.md.
The spectrum uses contiguous sections; gaps up to four samples are linearly interpolated only for spectral estimation.
The CSV protocol has no CRC, so payload bit errors cannot be ruled out by timestamp checks alone.
For a notch50 capture, the 49-51 Hz metric describes the filtered stream and is not a measurement of attenuation before the PL notch.
A dominant common mode or periodic component is a data-quality warning, not a diagnosis of the hardware fault source.
